42000001967.title: Almost Lover
42000001967.syn: Evelyn returns from her prenatal checkup to find her husband massaging oil onto his first love's belly. When Evelyn suffers a severe allergic reaction, he locks her in a room and ignores her pain—she loses the baby. Shattered, she walks away and rebuilds at her friend's architecture firm. Months later, Edward finds her at the love-lock bridge where they vowed forever, threatening to jump unless she forgives him. Will Evelyn save the man who destroyed her, or let him fall?

42000000808.title: Christmas With a Country Bad Boy
42000000808.syn: After a sold-out world tour, country music’s good girl returns home for Christmas to rest—only to be cornered by her money-hungry family pressuring her to sign away her estate. When her label sends its scandal-ridden bad boy to rehab his image, she least expects him to be the one who helps her fight back, reclaim her voice, and take control of her life again.

41000110515.title: Escape With Boss's Baby
41000110515.syn: Hermione Garcia is a famous computer genius and the heiress to the Garcia family,the wealthiest family in the South. She falls in love with Chris Evans, the President of LM Corporation, after he saves her at a banquet three years ago. To seek a genuine connection, Hermione conceals her identity and takes on the role of Chris's chief secretary, secretly dating him for three years.

41000112807.title: Food, Love, Robots
41000112807.syn: Seven years after her soulmate Elliot’s sudden death, Lily’s quiet Christmas is upended when her and Elliot’s son Evan’s wish comes true: Elliot returns. But this Elliot is a humanoid robot, programmed with her late boyfriend’s memories. As Lily’s heart reopens to love, she must navigate the charming chaos of family, romance, and technology, discovering whether this second chance at happiness is real or just a perfect AI program.

41000116783.title: The Hockey Star's Remorse
41000116783.syn: Six years ago, nerdy Evie spent a magical night with her crush,  hockey star Timothy—only to learn it was all a bet. Now a successful producer, she crosses paths with him again. In front of reporters, Timothy publicly apologizes and reveals he's been waiting for Evie ever since. Within an hour, #FindEvie is trending at number one.
